_comment: Xolotl xolotl-inkling serving orcarouter Inkling-2-Mini-abliterated Mix-16G (text only) on an RTX 4090.
Used by docker/xolotl/compose.yaml; paths are inside the container (/models = /opt/models on loom).
512K context with the global-layer K/V at k8v4 (q8_0 K, Hadamard-rotated q4_0 V; the sliding rings stay f16).
DSpark drafter = unsloth dspark/dspark-Inkling-2-Mini-BF16.gguf (the pre-mainline format Xolotl reads).
Xolotl drafts only on greedy requests; sampled requests decode normally.
Tokenizer pack exported by tools/inkling/export_tokenizer.py from thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini.
